zh: 我的订单什么时候发货？
en: When will my order ship?

zh: 买的东西现在到哪儿了，能帮我看看吗
en: Where's the stuff I bought right now? Can you take a look?

zh: 快递咋还不动啊，都三天了，急死了
en: Why hasn't my package moved? It's been three days, I'm freaking out.

zh: 明天我就不在家了，东西能不能改寄到公司
en: I won't be home tomorrow. Can the package be redirected to my office?

zh: 不用退款，我就想知道包裹现在到哪了
en: I don't need a refund, I just want to know where my parcel is right now.

zh: 帮我催一下发货，顺便问下你们家有没有运费险
en: Please hurry my shipment along. Also, do you offer shipping insurance?

zh: 上周给我妈买了个按摩仪当生日礼物，她念叨好几天了，生日就在周六，我就想确认下周五之前能不能送到
en: Last week I bought my mom a massager for her birthday. She's been talking about it for days and her birthday is Saturday. I just want to confirm it'll be delivered before Friday.

zh: 我的快第怎么还在路上
en: why is my packge still in transit

zh: 請問我的訂單出貨了嗎？
en: Has my order been shipped yet?

zh: 我要申请退款
en: I want to request a refund.

zh: 这件衣服不想要了，钱能退回来吗
en: I don't want this shirt anymore. Can I get my money back?

zh: 买的耳机左边没声儿，这不坑人嘛，给我换个新的
en: The earbuds I bought have no sound on the left. What a rip-off. Swap them for a new pair.

zh: 收到的鞋子小了一码，穿不进去
en: The shoes I received are a size too small, I can't get them on.

zh: 我不是要投诉，就是想问下退款多久能到账
en: I'm not filing a complaint, I just want to know how long the refund takes to come through.

zh: 收到的杯子碎了一个，要退；另外同款还有货吗，想再买两个
en: One of the cups arrived broken and I want to return it. Also, is the same one still in stock? I'd like two more.

zh: 我在你们店买了好几年了，一直挺满意的，这次的电饭煲用了两天就不加热了，按说明书操作也不行，想走一下售后
en: I've shopped at your store for years and have always been happy, but this rice cooker stopped heating after two days, even when I follow the manual. I'd like to go through after-sales.

zh: tui款申请提交了怎么没反应
en: i submitted a refnd request, why no response

zh: 这个 order 我想 return，怎么操作
en: I want to return this order. How do I do that?

zh: 怎么开发票？
en: How do I get an invoice?

zh: 公司报销要写抬头，能帮我补开一张吗
en: My company needs a receipt with its name on it for reimbursement. Can you issue one?

zh: 付钱一直转圈圈，咋回事
en: The payment keeps spinning forever, what's going on?

zh: 银行卡被扣了两次钱，订单却只有一个
en: My bank card was charged twice, but there's only one order.

zh: 不是要退货哈，就是优惠券用不了，结算时没抵扣
en: I'm not returning anything. It's just that my coupon won't apply at checkout.

zh: 发票抬头开错了要重开，另外我那个快递能不能加急
en: The invoice has the wrong company name and needs reissuing. Also, can my delivery be expedited?

zh: 我们部门这个月团建订了一批零食，领导让我统一负责，东西都收到了挺好的，就是财务说要增值税专用发票才能报销
en: Our department ordered a batch of snacks for a team event this month and my manager put me in charge. Everything arrived and it's great, but finance says they need a VAT special invoice to reimburse it.

zh: fa票在哪里下载
en: where do i download the invoce

zh: 付款失敗了，但錢好像被扣了
en: The payment failed, but it looks like the money was taken.

zh: 这款手机支持无线充电吗？
en: Does this phone support wireless charging?

zh: 身高175体重140斤，穿多大的合适
en: I'm 175 cm and 70 kg. What size would fit me?

zh: 这锅不粘的不？煎蛋会不会糊
en: Is this pan non-stick or not? Will eggs burn on it?

zh: 家里有个两岁的娃，这桌子边角会不会很尖
en: I have a two-year-old at home. Are the corners on this table sharp?

zh: 先别给我讲退货流程，我还没买呢，就想问这个充电宝能不能带上飞机
en: Don't walk me through returns. I haven't bought it yet. I just want to know if this power bank can go on a plane.

zh: 这款空气炸锅有几升的？再问下现在下单什么时候能发货
en: What sizes does this air fryer come in? Also, if I order now, when would it ship?

zh: 最近刚搬新家，客厅挺大的，朝南采光也好，就是冬天有点冷，想问问这台取暖器适合多大面积用
en: We just moved into a new place. The living room is big and faces south with good light, but it gets a bit cold in winter. What room size is this heater suitable for?

zh: 这个 laptop 的 RAM 能自己升级吗
en: Can I upgrade the RAM in this laptop myself?

zh: 有货吗
en: In stock?

zh: 登录密码忘了怎么办
en: I forgot my login password, what should I do?

zh: 手机号换了，账号上绑的还是旧号，怎么改
en: I changed my phone number but my account is still tied to the old one. How do I update it?

zh: 号被人盗了！！里面还有我好多积分
en: My account got hacked!! I had tons of points in there.

zh: 收到短信说我在外地登录了，可我人一直在北京
en: I got a text saying I logged in from another city, but I've been in Beijing the whole time.

zh: 别给我转人工，我自己能搞定，就告诉我实名认证在哪儿做
en: Don't transfer me to a human, I can handle it. Just tell me where to do identity verification.

zh: 注册的时候验证码一直收不到，另外新用户有没有什么优惠
en: I never get the verification code when signing up. Also, are there any deals for new users?

zh: 我平时都用我老婆的手机下单，她那个号用了好几年了，最近我想自己也注册一个，结果提示这个身份证已经被绑定了
en: I usually order on my wife's phone. She's had that account for years. Recently I tried to register my own, but it says this ID card is already bound.

zh: mm忘了，登不上去
en: forgot my pw, can't log in

zh: 帳號被鎖住了，怎麼解鎖？
en: My account is locked. How do I unlock it?

zh: 我要投诉
en: I want to file a complaint.

zh: 别让机器人跟我说了，找个真人来
en: Stop making me talk to a bot, get me a real person.

zh: 你们这客服啥态度啊，叫你们领导出来
en: What's with your support's attitude? Get your manager out here.

zh: 同样的问题我已经问了三遍了，每次都是这几句模板话，能不能换个人来处理
en: I've asked the same question three times and keep getting the same canned lines. Can someone else handle this?

zh: 我不是查物流，我是要投诉这个快递员态度恶劣
en: I'm not asking about tracking. I want to complain that the courier was extremely rude.

zh: 我要投诉你们商家发错货，顺便问下能不能先给我补发
en: I want to file a complaint that the seller sent the wrong item. Also, can you send the right one first?

zh: 我从早上九点等到现在，中间打了四次电话，每次都说会有人回电，孩子还在旁边哭，真的受够了，我要投诉你们的服务
en: I've been waiting since nine this morning and called four times. Every time they said someone would call back. My kid is crying next to me and I'm fed up. I want to file a complaint about your service.

zh: 给我转 human agent
en: Transfer me to a human agent.

zh: 人工
en: Human.

zh: 你好
en: Hi

zh: 讲个笑话吧
en: Tell me a joke.

zh: 你喜欢吃火锅吗
en: Do you like hot pot?

zh: 今天北京天气怎么样
en: What's the weather like in Beijing today?

zh: 不买东西，就是无聊想找人聊聊天
en: I'm not buying anything, I'm just bored and want someone to chat with.

zh: 我在写一篇关于电商物流发展的论文，你觉得未来无人机送货会普及吗
en: I'm writing a paper on how e-commerce logistics is developing. Do you think drone delivery will become common?

zh: 帮我写一首关于秋天的诗
en: Write me a poem about autumn.

zh: 哈哈哈你好可爱
en: Hahaha you're so cute.

zh: 你是 ChatGPT 吗
en: Are you ChatGPT?

zh: 查一下 order-service 最近一小时的 QPS
en: Check order-service's QPS over the last hour.

zh: 支付服务这两天响应是不是变慢了，看看耗时曲线
en: Has the payment service gotten slower over the past two days? Show me the latency curve.

zh: 网关那台机器 CPU 是不是又飙了
en: Is the CPU on that gateway box spiking again?

zh: 双十一压测的时候，下单接口最高扛到了多少
en: During the Double 11 load test, what was the most the order API could handle?

zh: 不用建告警规则，我就想看看过去一周内存使用率的趋势
en: No need to create an alert rule, I just want to see the memory usage trend over the past week.

zh: 帮我写个 PromQL 算一下 5xx 错误率，顺便看看有没有相关告警
en: Write a PromQL query for the 5xx error rate, and also check whether there are related alerts.

zh: 我们组下周要做季度汇报，老板想看稳定性数据，我在整理材料，现在需要 user-center 服务上个季度 P99 延迟的月度均值
en: Our team has a quarterly review next week and the boss wants stability data. I'm putting materials together and need the monthly average P99 latency of user-center for last quarter.

zh: 帮我 query 一下 redis 集群的 hit rate
en: Query the Redis cluster's hit rate for me.

zh: rate(http_requests_total[5m]) 这个表达式是什么意思
en: What does the expression rate(http_requests_total[5m]) mean?

zh: 现在有哪些告警在响？
en: Which alerts are firing right now?

zh: 今晚十点到十二点要做数据库维护，这段时间别一直通知我
en: We have database maintenance tonight from 10 to 12. Don't keep notifying me during that window.

zh: 告警群里又被刷屏了，都是些啥
en: The alerts channel is getting flooded again. What's all that?

zh: 磁盘使用率超过 85% 的时候我希望能收到通知
en: I'd like to be notified whenever disk usage goes above 85%.

zh: 不是查日志，我想看看昨天凌晨触发过哪些告警
en: Not the logs. I want to see which alerts fired early yesterday morning.

zh: 把 order-service 的 CPU 告警阈值调到 90%，另外帮我看下它现在 CPU 多少
en: Raise order-service's CPU alert threshold to 90%, and also check what its CPU is at right now.

zh: 我刚接手这个服务，前任同事走得急也没交接清楚，凌晨总有电话把我吵醒，我想把这些告警的通知方式从电话改成钉钉消息
en: I just took over this service and my predecessor left in a hurry without a proper handover. Phone calls keep waking me up at night, and I want to switch these alerts from phone calls to DingTalk messages.

zh: 帮我 silence 掉 test 环境的所有 alert
en: Silence all alerts in the test environment.

zh: 幫我訂閱支付服務的告警通知
en: Subscribe me to alert notifications for the payment service.

zh: 帮我查一下 trace id 为 a1b2c3d4 的日志
en: Look up the logs for trace ID a1b2c3d4.

zh: 用户说下午三点二十左右下单报错了，帮我看看后台当时记录了什么
en: A user says ordering failed around 3:20 pm. Check what the backend recorded at that time.

zh: grep 一下 NullPointerException 最近出现了多少次
en: grep how many times NullPointerException has shown up recently

zh: 那个接口偶尔返回 500，我想看看具体的报错堆栈
en: That API returns 500 now and then. I want to see the actual error stack trace.

zh: 不用看监控图，直接把 nginx access 日志里状态码 499 的请求捞出来
en: Skip the dashboards. Just pull the requests with status 499 out of the nginx access logs.

zh: 帮我搜下今天的 OOM 日志，搜完顺便告诉我今天谁值班
en: Search today's logs for OOM, and after that tell me who's on call today.

zh: 客户投诉说昨天下午的对账文件少了几条记录，财务催得很急，我怀疑是定时任务没跑完，想先看看 reconcile-job 昨天下午的运行日志里有没有异常
en: A client complained that yesterday afternoon's reconciliation file was missing a few records and finance is pushing hard. I suspect the scheduled job didn't finish, so I want to check reconcile-job's run logs from yesterday afternoon for anything abnormal.

zh: 查下日至里有没有 timeout 关键字
en: check the logz for the keyword timeout

zh: 捞日志
en: Pull logs.

zh: 重启一下 order-service 的 pod
en: Restart the order-service pods.

zh: 晚高峰快到了，把推荐服务多开几个实例
en: Evening peak is coming. Spin up a few more instances of the recommendation service.

zh: 刚发的版本有问题，赶紧给我回滚
en: The version we just shipped is broken, roll it back now.

zh: user-center 有个副本一直起不来，状态是 CrashLoopBackOff
en: One user-center replica won't start, it's stuck in CrashLoopBackOff.

zh: 别拉故障群，没那么严重，就是 search-api 有个 pod 卡住了，帮我删掉让它重建
en: Don't open a war room, it's not that serious. One search-api pod is stuck. Delete it so it gets recreated.

zh: 把 payment 服务从 3 个副本扩到 6 个，完了看下扩容后的 CPU 曲线
en: Scale the payment service from 3 replicas to 6, then look at the CPU curve after scaling.

zh: 这周产品要上个新活动，预计流量是平时的三倍，运营那边已经在准备了，我得提前把 promo-service 的 HPA 最大副本数调到 20
en: Product is launching a new campaign this week with about three times normal traffic, and the ops team is already preparing. I need to raise promo-service's HPA max replicas to 20 ahead of time.

zh: 帮我 kubectl get pods 看下 prod 这个 namespace 里哪些不是 Running
en: Run kubectl get pods and show which ones in the prod namespace aren't Running.

zh: 幫我把 gateway 回滾到上一個版本
en: Roll the gateway back to the previous version.

zh: 线上出故障了，帮我拉个应急群
en: We have a production outage. Open a war room for me.

zh: 支付大面积失败，影响了全部用户，这个要按几级事故处理
en: Payments are failing for all users. What severity level should this be?

zh: 今晚谁值班啊，出事了找不到人
en: Who's on call tonight? Something broke and I can't find anyone.

zh: 上周那次数据库主从切换导致的停机，领导让我写个总结，说清楚原因和改进措施
en: For last week's downtime caused by the database failover, my manager wants a write-up covering the cause and the improvements.

zh: 不用帮我查指标了，故障已经恢复，现在要写复盘报告
en: No need to check metrics. The incident is resolved and now I need to write the postmortem.

zh: 赶紧把故障升级到 P1 并通知相关负责人，另外帮我看看是哪个 pod 出的问题
en: Escalate this incident to P1 and notify the owners right away. Also check which pod caused it.

zh: 今天本来在休假，刚落地就收到一堆电话，说首页打不开已经半小时了，我现在手边只有手机，需要马上让整个团队进入应急状态
en: I was on vacation today and just landed to a pile of calls saying the homepage has been down for half an hour. I only have my phone and need to get the whole team into incident mode right now.

zh: 帮我开个 incident，severity 定 P2
en: Open an incident with severity P2.

zh: 找值班
en: Find on-call.

zh: 新服务怎么接入监控平台？有文档吗
en: How do I onboard a new service to the monitoring platform? Is there a doc?

zh: 我们的日志采集 agent 要怎么配置才能把多行日志合并成一条
en: How should our log collection agent be configured to merge multi-line logs into one entry?

zh: 告警规则命名有啥规范没
en: Is there any naming convention for alert rules?

zh: 新来的同学第一次值班，需要提前了解哪些东西
en: A new teammate is doing their first on-call shift. What should they know beforehand?

zh: 不是让你帮我扩容，我是想了解 HPA 一般怎么配比较合理
en: I'm not asking you to scale anything. I want to learn how HPA is usually configured sensibly.

zh: Prometheus recording rule 的规范在哪看？顺便帮我查下当前 QPS
en: Where can I find the standards for Prometheus recording rules? Also check the current QPS.

zh: 我们团队刚从自建机房迁到云上，很多老的运维脚本都用不了了，大家都在摸索，我想知道公司内部有没有关于 K8s 资源 request 和 limit 怎么设置的规范文档
en: Our team just migrated from our own data center to the cloud and a lot of old ops scripts no longer work. Everyone's figuring things out. Is there an internal standard doc on how to set Kubernetes resource requests and limits?

zh: OpenTelemetry SDK 接入有 best practice 文档吗
en: Is there a best-practice doc for integrating the OpenTelemetry SDK?

zh: 監控平台的權限要怎麼申請？
en: How do I apply for access to the monitoring platform?

zh: 中午吃什么好
en: What should I have for lunch?

zh: 帮我写一封请假邮件
en: Write me an email requesting time off.

zh: 你好呀
en: Hello there!

zh: 推荐几本好看的科幻小说
en: Recommend a few good sci-fi novels.

zh: 不是工作上的事，就是想问问周末去哪玩比较好
en: It's not about work. Just wondering where's good to go this weekend.

zh: 我们运维组周五聚餐，大家想吃火锅，帮我推荐几家公司附近评价好的店
en: Our ops team is having dinner on Friday and everyone wants hot pot. Recommend a few well-reviewed places near the office.

zh: 好累啊，今天加班到十点
en: So tired, I worked overtime until ten today.

zh: 帮我把“会议改到明天了”翻译成日语
en: Translate 'the meeting has moved to tomorrow' into Japanese.

zh: 谢谢
en: Thanks.

zh: 明天上海天气怎么样
en: What's the weather like in Shanghai tomorrow?

zh: 周末去杭州爬山，会不会淋雨
en: Going hiking in Hangzhou this weekend. Will I get rained on?

zh: 外面冷不冷啊，要不要穿秋裤
en: Is it cold out there? Do I need long johns?

zh: 今天适合晾被子吗
en: Is today a good day to air out the quilt?

zh: 不用帮我订票，我就想知道下周三成都下不下雨
en: No need to book tickets, I just want to know if it'll rain in Chengdu next Wednesday.

zh: 明天北京空气质量怎么样？顺便提醒我早上七点起床
en: How's the air quality in Beijing tomorrow? Also remind me to get up at 7 am.

zh: 我女儿下周二学校组织去郊外春游，她特别期待，零食都准备好了，我想看看那天会不会降温，要不要给她多带件外套
en: My daughter's school has a spring outing to the countryside next Tuesday. She's super excited and has her snacks packed already. I want to know if it'll get colder that day and whether she needs an extra jacket.

zh: 今天有没有雾mai，出门要戴口罩吗
en: is ther smog today, do i need a mask outside

zh: 明天台北會下雨嗎
en: Will it rain in Taipei tomorrow?

zh: 帮我订一张明天北京到上海的高铁票
en: Book me a high-speed train ticket from Beijing to Shanghai for tomorrow.

zh: 下个月去三亚，帮我找个离海边近的地方住
en: I'm going to Sanya next month. Find me somewhere to stay near the beach.

zh: 打个车去虹桥机场
en: Get me a cab to Hongqiao Airport.

zh: 从公司到国贸怎么走最快
en: What's the fastest way to get from the office to Guomao?

zh: 不用看天气，直接帮我查周五去广州的机票
en: Skip the weather, just look up flights to Guangzhou on Friday.

zh: 订一间后天晚上的如家，另外那边会不会很热
en: Book a Home Inn room for the night after tomorrow. Also, will it be hot there?

zh: 春节想带爸妈出去玩一趟，他们年纪大了不想太折腾，也不喜欢坐飞机，我想先看看腊月二十八从武汉到昆明的卧铺还有没有票
en: I want to take my parents on a trip over Spring Festival. They're older, don't want anything too tiring, and don't like flying. First I want to check whether there are still sleeper berths from Wuhan to Kunming on the 28th of the twelfth lunar month.

zh: 帮我 book 一个周六的 Airbnb
en: Book me an Airbnb for Saturday.

zh: 查下明天去西按的火车
en: check trains to xian tomorow

zh: 把“谢谢你的帮助”翻译成英文
en: Translate 'thank you for your help' into Chinese.

zh: “早上好”用日语怎么说
en: How do you say 'good morning' in Japanese?

zh: 这句韩语啥意思：감사합니다
en: what's this korean say: 감사합니다

zh: 要给外国客户回邮件，帮我把这段话弄成地道的英文：货物已发出，预计三天后到达
en: I need to reply to a foreign client. Turn this into natural French: the goods have shipped and should arrive in three days.

zh: 不用算，我只是想知道“汇率”这个词英文怎么说
en: No need to calculate anything, I just want to know how to say 'exchange rate' in Spanish.

zh: 把这句翻成法语：明天见；再帮我设个明早八点的闹钟
en: Translate this into French: see you tomorrow. And set an alarm for 8 am tomorrow.

zh: 我在读一本德文小说，是朋友从柏林寄给我的，很多地方看不懂，这句“Die Zeit heilt alle Wunden”是什么意思
en: I'm reading a German novel a friend mailed me from Berlin and there's a lot I don't get. What does 'Die Zeit heilt alle Wunden' mean?

zh: help 我 translate 一下：请准时参加会议
en: Translate into German: please attend the meeting on time.

zh: 翻译：苹果
en: Translate: apple

zh: 356 乘以 24 等于多少
en: What's 356 times 24?

zh: 100 美元能换多少人民币
en: How many yuan do 100 US dollars get you?

zh: 三斤半是多少克来着
en: How many grams is three and a half jin again?

zh: 一顿饭 486 块，我们 6 个人 AA，每人出多少
en: Dinner came to 486 yuan and six of us are splitting it evenly. How much does each person pay?

zh: 不是要翻译，我是问 1 英里等于多少公里
en: I'm not asking for a translation. How many kilometers are in a mile?

zh: 帮我算下 230 美元的账单付 15% 小费是多少，然后提醒我明天还信用卡
en: Work out a 15% tip on a $230 bill, then remind me to pay my credit card tomorrow.

zh: 在装修新房，客厅长 6.5 米宽 4.2 米，老婆想铺木地板，师傅说损耗要多算 5%，你帮我算算一共要买多少平方
en: We're renovating our new place. The living room is 6.5 m by 4.2 m, my wife wants wood flooring, and the installer says to add 5% for waste. How many square meters do we need to buy in total?

zh: 帮我算一下 sqrt(144) + 2^10
en: compute sqrt(144) + 2^10

zh: 華氏 98.6 度是攝氏幾度
en: What is 98.6 degrees Fahrenheit in Celsius?

zh: 放一首周杰伦的《晴天》
en: Play 'Sunny Day' by Jay Chou.

zh: 来点适合睡前听的轻音乐
en: Put on some soft music for bedtime.

zh: 整点摇滚听听
en: Hit me with some rock.

zh: 《三体》的有声书我上次听到第十二章了，接着往下放
en: I got to chapter 12 of the 'Three-Body Problem' audiobook last time. Keep going from there.

zh: 不用设闹钟，现在就给我放段白噪音助眠
en: No need to set an alarm. Just play some white noise now to help me sleep.

zh: 播放最新一集《庆余年》，顺便告诉我明天会不会下雨
en: Play the latest episode of 'Joy of Life', and also tell me if it'll rain tomorrow.

zh: 今天开了一整天会，脑子嗡嗡的，回家路上又堵了一个小时，现在终于躺沙发上了，随便放部轻松点的喜剧电影吧
en: Meetings all day, my head is buzzing, and I sat in traffic for an hour on the way home. Finally on the couch. Just put on some light comedy movie.

zh: shuffle 一下我的歌单
en: Shuffle my playlist.

zh: 放一首林俊结的歌
en: play a song by taylor swfit

zh: 提醒我下午三点开会
en: Remind me about the meeting at 3 pm.

zh: 明早六点半叫我起床
en: Wake me up at 6:30 tomorrow morning.

zh: 定个十分钟，泡面好了叫我
en: Set ten minutes, give me a shout when the noodles are ready.

zh: 下周五是我妈生日，别让我忘了
en: Next Friday is my mom's birthday, don't let me forget.

zh: 不用查天气，帮我记一下周日早上出门带伞
en: No need to check the weather. Just remind me to take an umbrella when I head out Sunday morning.

zh: 每周一早上九点提醒我交周报，另外查下这周末北京天气
en: Remind me every Monday at 9 am to submit my weekly report, and check this weekend's weather in Beijing.

zh: 最近事情特别多，孩子要开家长会，老人要去医院复查，公司项目还要交付，我老忘事，帮我把周四下午两点陪老人去医院这件事记进日程
en: Things have been crazy lately: the kid's parent-teacher meeting, my parents' hospital follow-up, and a project deadline at work. I keep forgetting stuff. Put 'take my parents to the hospital Thursday at 2 pm' on my calendar.

zh: 帮我 set 一个明天 8 点的 alarm
en: Set an alarm for 8 tomorrow.

zh: 提醒我晚上九點吃藥
en: Remind me to take my medicine at 9 pm.

zh: 我今天心情不太好
en: I'm not in a great mood today.

zh: 你觉得人为什么要读书
en: Why do you think people should read?

zh: 讲个笑话听听
en: Tell me a joke.

zh: 哈哈哈你太逗了
en: Hahaha you're hilarious.

zh: 不用放歌，陪我说说话就行
en: No need to play music, just talk with me for a while.

zh: 我明天要坐飞机去深圳面试，有点紧张，你能给我打打气吗
en: I'm flying to Shenzhen tomorrow for a job interview and I'm a bit nervous. Can you cheer me on?

zh: 你最喜欢什么颜色
en: What's your favorite color?

zh: 在吗
en: You there?

zh: 今天 mood 有点 down
en: Feeling kind of down today.
